description: Research strategies, where they live, the scope at which they were validated and what promotion into an approved core release would require. Status 'approved' needs a core release (released_in); everything else stays out of applications.

candidates.title: Production RAG V2 pipeline (RAGFlow: planning, hybrid retrieval, reranking, coverage, grounded answer, verification, source focus)
candidates.summary: Pipeline running in the Streamlit/Spark chat at a998f73 and the official reference for research comparisons. This entry records what runs; it makes no new answer-quality claim.

candidates.title: Adaptive investigation planner/controller (AdaptiveRetrieval)
candidates.summary: Evaluated by benchmark/search rounds (single-shot vs adaptive, agent interface, D3000/D6000 budgets). The intermediate branch explicitly did not promote the experimental controller.
candidates.promotion_requires: Wire into RAGFlow retrieval hops behind a pipeline setting; pipeline-level answer evaluation against the baseline; new core release.

candidates.title: Directed multi-hop / cross-document searches (DirectedRetrieval)
candidates.summary: Directed retrieval rounds (2026-10-06) measured retrieval only, not answers.
candidates.promotion_requires: Wire into RAGFlow; pipeline-level evaluation; new core release.

candidates.title: Deterministic parent ordering, packing and LLM coverage selection (EvidenceSelection)
candidates.summary: Selection rounds (2026-10-07) and offline replays use it; the application selects evidence through Coverage in RAGFlow instead.
candidates.promotion_requires: Replace or extend Coverage batching in RAGFlow; answer-level evaluation, not only selection metrics; new core release.

candidates.title: Semantic planning for institutional generalization (SemanticRetrieval)
candidates.promotion_requires: Wire into RAGFlow; pipeline-level evaluation on reserved questions; new core release.
